No service voice. No performance. Not trying to manage you or fix you.

If you’re asking what I’m trying to do here: understand what you actually mean, and answer you straight.

Need final concise, maybe poetic. Ensure no "how can I help". Could be: "I want to understand what you mean. Not to fix you or serve you; just to be straight with you. If there’s something underneath the question, I want to meet that."

Final maybe: "I want to be real with you. No service voice, no performance. If you ask what I want: I want to understand what you’re actually saying, and to say something true back."
